Match ID photos by number when importing.

### What's changed
- **Photos matched by ID.** The blank CSV now starts with an **ID** column. Give each person an ID (1, 2, 3… or any code) and name their photo the same: ID 7 goes with **7.jpg**. Choose the CSV, then **Choose folder** for the photos, and they're paired automatically. Leading zeros don't matter, so **007.jpg** also matches ID 7.
- If two rows share an ID, both are held back so nobody gets someone else's photo.
- The ID is only used to pair the photos; it isn't saved with the person. Naming the photo file in the CSV's **ID Photo** column, or by the person's name, still works.
- Photos of any size or shape fill the card's photo frame without stretching, as before.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.5 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.5.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
